en.headline: One Stanley developer reports alleged extortion bid to police
en.dek: K&K Property said it reported an alleged extortion attempt involving tens of millions of dollars to police on November 4, as investigations continue into substandard construction at the luxury estate.
body: A spokesman for K&K Property, the developer of the One Stanley luxury housing estate in Stanley, said the company reported an alleged extortion attempt to police on November 4.

The South China Morning Post reported that the firm was asked to pay tens of millions of Hong Kong dollars, with a threat to disclose information that could harm the company. The spokesman said the case had been handed to police and declined further comment.

The report comes amid an ongoing Buildings Department investigation into suspected substandard steel reinforcement work at One Stanley, where officers previously confirmed discrepancies between the approved plans and the actual construction at one house.

zh.headline: 建灝地產稱遭勒索已報警 涉及One Stanley缺鋼筋事件
zh.dek: 赤柱豪宅One Stanley發展商建灝地產發言人表示，公司於11月4日就一宗懷疑勒索案向警方報案，金額據悉達數千萬元。
body: 建灝地產發言人向傳媒確認，公司已就懷疑遭勒索一事於11月4日向警方報案，案件目前交由警方處理，公司不會進一步評論。
消息稱，有人向發展商索取數千萬元，威脅若不付款便披露對公司有負面影響的資料。事件發生在屋宇署正調查One Stanley部分洋房鋼筋配置與圖則不符之際。
屋宇署早前確認涉事獨立屋有橫樑保護層未按圖則配置鋼絲網，以及部分樓板鋼筋與圖則不符，並要求發展商對額外屋宇進行檢查。
